cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a starship data archive — standing; a domed planetarium lounge during an early stargazing breakfast — she breaks a round bread roll in half and studies the spiral of its crumb with quiet amusement before taking a bite; the boarding stairs of a small plane on a sunny airfield — pulls a hard-shell travel suitcase along behind her by its handle; a small mountain-path shrine at the Slope of the Fallen Phoenix — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a quiet tidal observatory with a narrow saltwater wading basin — she draws a small circle in the damp salt crust on the rim of the basin; a cinema lobby with a popcorn counter — standing at a waist-high railing or sill; a steel catwalk high inside a giant hangar — crouching down low; a retro-futurist home of rounded chrome appliances and soft panels — reclining on her back; a desert oasis at golden hour — standing and leaning her upper body forward toward the camera from the hips; the cockpit of a small starship of her world — standing; a private karaoke room with spinning coloured lights — coils the cable of a microphone loosely around her hand; an old brush-and-ink shop in a heritage quarter — carries her keepsake low at her side; the cushioned foredeck of a moored yacht — peels the wrapper off an ice pop on a wooden stick
